mentions.name: OpenAdapt
mentions.description: OpenAdapt is an open source GUI automation tool designed to be reliable enough for enterprise applications like EHRs, ERPs, and Citrix apps. Instead of repeatedly querying a model at runtime, it uses models to learn or repair a workflow and then compiles it into a deterministic form, so normal runs can execute with zero model calls. Workflows include preconditions, postconditions/evidence checks to verify that actions had the intended effect, and halt when state is ambiguous, with halted decisions sent to a phone for human approval or rejection.
mentions.problem: Agent-style GUI automation that repeatedly asks a model what to do next is unreliable, and it is hard to verify that an action actually produced the intended effect.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on OpenAdapt: https://github.com/OpenAdaptAI

It’s an open source attempt at making GUI automation reliable enough for things like EHRs, ERPs, Citrix apps, etc.
